text:
tess: Quick report — on a 320px viewport the table's action menu wraps and pushes the row height up when sidebar is collapsed. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/wrap-320.png
ram: Repro'd on iPhone SE simulator. Looks like action column (⋯) is inline and has no min-width so it drops.
li: Could we convert that column to a fixed 40px affordance at < 360px and surface a compact flyout? Keeps rows stable.
tess: That was my thought. Also the sticky header jumps when the table becomes horizontally scrollable. Not great.
ram: Two small fixes: reserve the affordance width in the grid and add `contain: layout` on the row. Also avoid `overflow:hidden` on body when toggling sidebar.
li: UX question — icon-only affordance vs "Details" pill? Icon saves space but less discoverable. We should A/B test.
tess: Hallway test: 8 of 10 people tapped a pill labelled "Details" faster than an icon.
ram: Ok let's default to a 44px pill with visible label "Details" on first canary, and an icon variant behind flag `mobile_table_compact_icon`. Add `aria-label` either way.
li: Accessibility: when flyout opens trap focus, add `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"`. Return focus to the trigger on close.
tess: Also ensure hit target >= 44px and tooltip on long press for mobile.
design-bot: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3012 — includes mocks, accessibility checklist, and telemetry event `ui.table.compact_details_opened`.
ram: QA list: iPhone SE Safari, Pixel 3 Chrome, Keyboard only, VoiceOver + TalkBack, check large fonts.
li: I'll add the CSS snippet to the PR: ```css
@media (max-width: 360px){
  .row { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 44px; gap:8px; }
  .details-trigger{ min-width:44px; }
}
```
tess: Great. Can we canary behind flag `compact_table_details` and measure CTR on the pill?
ram: Yep. I'll wire telemetry and rollout plan. Tagging @qa for passes once PR is up. :thumbsup:
